material.acceptance_criteria: rust/data builds three presets; sim builds for wasm32 in CI with the loader wired.
material.description:
Load a preset as a directory of .star files (moba, rts, rpg), each generating the same sim-facing tables. Keep the existing SC2-shaped map.star and economy.star as the rts preset and add moba and rpg presets beside them.
blocked_by: engine-preset-data-loader-blocker-gm-oscraft-sc2-alt-1-p5 (see that row for the consumer and ownership facts).
material.resolution: Preset dirs rust/data/moba and rust/data/rpg added (16 .star); loader wiring in engine-preset-data-loader-wire. Lane, tower, gold, xp, inventory and quest content uses stand-in DSL mappings, to be replaced with real builtins.
material.subject: Preset directories loaded from data, one generator per genre
